note: The figure prints no time origin: time is counted from the timing line that carries the three deceleration rulers (0 ms), so only differences of time are measured; the timing lines are 10 ms apart (the figure's 0.01 s bar). Deceleration is in g as printed (G's), positive upward, converted with standard gravity; 0 g is each ruler's printed zero, not the dashed line drawn about 0.7 to 1.0 g above it. Samples are in drawing order and may share a time on a steep flank
